newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos and swaps idle in late dealings.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos and swaps idle in late dealings.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were idle, FRNs and fixed coupon bonds were firmer and ecu/drachma was higher in late Friday trade, dealers said.
Depos and swaps were constant late on Friday, a foreign bank dealer said.
"Depos and forex forwards are idle. Interest rates are almost stagnant and there is no buying interest," the dealer said.
The market was nervous in the past two weeks and this stabilisation was expected, the dealer added.
"I find this consolidation trend natural after the market's recent nervousness," the dealer said.
Bond dealers said buying interest for non-taxable fixed coupon bonds continued.
"The market has been quiet but there is some buying interest for fixed coupon bonds of November 96 and December 96," the dealer said.
Ecu/drachma was trading at 307.20-30 late on Friday, a foreign bank forex dealer said.
"Ecu/drachma is trading at 307.20-30, a little higher than its fixind rate," the dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 157.20/30 from Friday's 157.300 fix, the dollar at 270.82/92 drachmas from 270.840 and the ecu at 307.00/10 from 307.220 drachmas.
